# AL-JADRIYA Group

> AL-JADRIYA Group delivers engineering, medical, robotics, and clean-energy solutions across Iraq, Jordan, and the wider region.

AL-JADRIYA Group operates four divisions: Oil & Gas (supply only), Medical, Robotics & Education, and Clean Energy. We supply equipment, manage turnkey projects, and provide training and after-sales support.
